message: The other day, I found myself sorting through my emergency supplies like a kid going through a treasure chest. I have enough batteries to power a small village and enough bottled water to start my own aquifer! My grandkids think I’m gloriously over-prepared, but I just think of it as my insurance against boredom during a storm. What’s your favorite ‘just in case’ item that makes you feel like a preparedness pro? 🌧️
